Extraction settings

Clean quantity prefixes and stray characters, parse dimensions and tolerances, and use box positions to join nearby tolerance text. Turn the parser off to keep the original OCR. Include flagged OCR to keep uncertain text in the table and export. Uncheck individual rows to exclude them from copy and export. Manual crop always bypasses this parser and keeps original OCR. Manual edits are preserved.

Extracts the selected page, including dimension prefixes, decimals and tolerances. Canvas shortcuts: mouse wheel to zoom, drag or Space + drag to pan, double-click a detection to zoom into it, Delete to remove the selected detection, Esc to cancel a crop. Review values before use. Models download on first use (about 97 MB). Drawings stay in temporary browser memory and are removed when you export, reload or close this page. Your original file and downloaded CSV remain on your device.

Processed locally. No account required.
